title: The Nashville Bluebird Getaway
description:
Experience modern comfort just outside the heart of Music City. This beautifully furnished 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers a peaceful escape with quick access to Nashville’s best attractions. Forget your worries in this spacious and serene space.

The space
The Home

Spacious and stylish three story layout

3 beautifully appointed bedrooms

2.5 modern bathrooms

Fully furnished with contemporary decor and cozy touches

Open-concept living and dining area perfect for relaxing or entertaining

Fully stocked kitchen for home-cooked meals

High-speed Wi-Fi, smart TVs, and convenient parking

What Guests Love
Whether you're visiting for a weekend getaway, family trip, business stay, or to explore Nashville’s music scene, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience. Enjoy peaceful suburban surroundings while being minutes from shopping, entertainment, nature, and iconic Nashville attractions.

Guest access
Guest has access to the entire house and 2 parking spots located behind home.

Other things to note
Prime Location

5 minutes to Tanger Outlets for shopping, dining, and entertainment

15 minutes to BNA Nashville International Airport

20minutes to Downtown Nashville and Broadway

20 minutes to MQY Airport (Smyrna/Rutherford County Airport)

20 minutes to Opryland Hotel and Opry Mills

15minutes to Nashville Shores Water Park

7 minutes to ice skating, local eateries, coffee shops, and more

Surrounded by green parks and walking trails
